article.name: craft
article.review_scope: Verified repository identity, default branch, current head, pinned catalog revision, and citation targets. Did not redo an implementation assessment.
article.summary: The catalog locator is canonical as listed: official GitHub metadata identifies public, non-fork drobins25/craft on main, and the catalog-pinned SHA exists there. The prior neo4j-labs/create-context-graph destination and missing-SHA conclusion were caused by mis-targeted lookups and are withdrawn. This review corrects the source links and identity claims only; implementation and benchmark results remain unassessed.

review_note.resolution: The listed repository URL is canonical and does not redirect to neo4j-labs/create-context-graph. The catalog-pinned SHA resolves in the listed repository. The previous review queried the wrong repository, so its redirect and missing-commit claims were incorrect.
